Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Our critical communications, video security and command center technologies support public safety agencies and enterprises alike, enabling the coordination that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals and safer businesses. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

Motorola’s Software Enterprise organization is a fast-paced organization at the front line of driving growth throughout Motorola Solutions. The Command Center Software team is building public safety solutions that bring the capabilities of the suite together into a single, user-centered workflow and help public safety manage data across their operation.

Job Description

The product owner is responsible for the ownership and managing of the backlog for their assigned value stream(s), contributes to the product roadmap, and understands customer and market needs for the PremierOne product. The product owner works in partnership with the product manager and relies on their technical knowledge and background to define user stories and acceptance criteria, engage with assigned Engineering teams, and groom the backlog. The ability to deeply understand technical architecture, define engineering behind features, and translate high-level customer functional requirements into technical for development is a crucial skill. In addition, the ability to describe the impact of technical requirements on customers, non-technical sales, and support resources is a must.

This position will be responsible for filling the agile product owner role for the PremierOne product. In this role, the product owner champions the needs of the user, customer, and other stakeholders throughout the development process to ensure that what is delivered meets the goals, objectives, and desired outcomes of the project. To be successful, one must manage multiple projects simultaneously, at various stages of their development, from idea to completed feature.

Responsibilities

  • Develop strong relationships with UI/UX teams and work in close partnership with research and design colleagues
  • Actively involved in initiative and epic refinement as an integral member of the Product Management team
  • Responsible for building, editing, and maintaining the team backlog, including user stories, defects, and research spikes
  • Review and prioritize the backlog as part of the preparatory work for release and sprint planning, including coordination of dependencies with other POs
  • Contribute to the roadmap
  • Involved in release planning, reviewing vision, and content presentations to assigned engineering team(s)
  • Collaborate with the team to detail user stories with acceptance criteria
  • Maintain the proper flow of features, user stories, and acceptance criteria in the backlog
  • Agree on accepted story completion, including validating that the story meets acceptance criteria and that it complies with the Definition of Done (DoD)
  • Understand the scope of needed research spikes and collaborate with Engineering to assist with decision-making and sequencing of the critical technological infrastructures
  • Collaborate with the team and any other stakeholders in the team demo
  • Lead and participate in the appropriate agile ceremonies

Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • 4+ years of progressive experience in business analysis, product ownership, product planning, product management, or engineering
  • Agile/Scrum experience
  • Technical Knowledge of Enterprise Hardware Platforms.
  • Firm understanding of software design, user interaction, and user interface design
  • Deep technical knowledge in software development methodologies
  • Technical skills and knowledge of on-prem or cloud services and development
  • Align with the enhanced focus on prioritizing and developing important aspects of mission-critical products, such as availability, reliability, and stability
  • Excellent communication skills - both verbal and written
  • Polished presentation skills for internal and external audiences
  • Proactive, enthusiastic attitude toward challenging problems
  • Capable of quickly evaluating and prioritizing new projects alongside customer feedback
  • Strong ability to take complex user requirements and distill them into a format that is intuitive and clear to developers as well as non-technical staff
  • Ability to research and analyze project requirements from various stakeholders
  • Build consensus among stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a diverse team spread across multiple continents in a fast-moving environment
  • Ability to multi-task among various assignments
  • Understanding of product management and product ownership principles
  • Fluent in English

Desired Skills

  • Experience utilizing product and project management tools such as Aha!, Jira, and DevOps
  • Experience within the Public Safety industry is a plus

description:
Overview

Um retrato do seu dia

Trabalhar como representante da SIEMENS ENERGY junto ao cliente, executando os serviços de assistência técnica remota ou na plataforma quanto requerido, suportando remotamente a equipe offshore (SIEMENS ENERGY e CLIENTE) responsável pela execução das manutenções preditivas, preventivas, corretivas e suporte operacional aos pacotes de Moto e Turbo compressão de gás de fornecimento da SIEMENS ENERGY para o devido projeto.

Como você causará um impacto

  • Prestar suporte as atividades de troubleshooting, análise de falhas em todas as fases de partida, operação, parada dos Turbocompressores e Motocompressores. À distância, prestar assistência técnica, auxiliar e orientar as equipes de manutenção da plataforma, durante a execução de rotinas de manutenção programadas ou não, sempre que solicitado;
  • Orientar as equipes do Cliente e Siemens Energy sobre as melhores práticas de manutenção dos Turbocompressores e Motocompressores. Auxiliar e prestar suporte na elaboração e/ou revisão de procedimentos padronizados para tarefas de manutenção dos Turbocompressores e Motocompressores;
  • Assessorar na elaboração de procedimentos de calibração dos dispositivos de controle e respectivos cartões, detalhando todas as tarefas necessárias;
  • Suportar na obtenção de informações técnicas atualizadas dos equipamentos atendidos pertencentes aos pacotes fornecidos pela Siemens Energy; Suportar desvios em resultados de técnicas de preditiva fornecidos pelo cliente (exemplo: análise de vibrações, desempenho de equipamentos) e propor soluções;
  • Prestar suporte na avaliação da obsolescência e verificar com os fornecedores as possíveis soluções; Propor modificações visando melhorar os equipamentos, sempre que identificada a possibilidade ou ainda que as melhorias sejam através dos boletins emitidos pela contratada;
  • Auxiliar no planejamento dos serviços de manutenção de grande porte (serviços emergenciais ou intervenções planejadas) nos equipamentos pertencentes aos pacotes de geração e compressão.

O que esperamos que você nos traga

  • Graduação em engenharia ou Técnico (Mecânica ou Mecatrônica);
  • Experiência de embarques em contratos de assistência técnica em equipamentos rotativos; comissionamento e/ou troubleshooting em Compressores Centrífugos DATUM Dresser Rand; Capacidade de efetuar troubleshooting remotamente;
  • Suportar remotamente Desmontagem e montagem de compressores centrífugos, turbocompressores e motocompressores; Validar Inspeção visual e dimensional de componentes como mancais, rotores e selos; Disponibilidade para viagens e embarques; Experiência em Instalação e alinhamento de compressores e seus periféricos (gearboxes, VORECONs, sensores);
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe, junto ao cliente para programar as manutenções offshore; Conhecimento de controle de Surges de compressores.
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Estar alinhado e ativo com os requisitos e diretrizes de HSE, Qualidade e compliance

Sobre a equipe

Nossa equipe é responsável pela execução dos contratos de Assistência técnica, Operações, LTP e outros para os nossos clientes offshore e contamos com um grupo com experiência consolidada nos equipamentos cobertos em nossos contratos.

Quem é a Siemens Energy?

Na Siemens Energy, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa de tecnologia de energia. Atendemos à crescente demanda de energia em mais de 90 países, ao mesmo tempo em que garantimos que nosso clima seja protegido. Com ~100.000 funcionários dedicados, não apenas geramos eletricidade para mais de 16% da comunidade global, mas também usamos nossa tecnologia para ajudar a proteger as pessoas e o meio ambiente.

Nossa equipe global está comprometida em tornar a energia sustentável, confiável e acessível uma realidade, expandindo os limites do que é possível. Mantemos um legado de 150 anos de inovação que incentiva nossa busca por pessoas que apoiarão nosso foco em descarbonização, novas tecnologias e transformação energética.

Confira este vídeo para saber mais sobre a Siemens Energy:

Nosso compromisso com a diversidade

Para nossa sorte, não somos todos iguais. Por meio da diversidade, geramos energia. Funcionamos com inclusão e nossa energia criativa combinada é alimentada por mais de 130 nacionalidades. A Siemens Energy celebra o caráter — não importa a origem étnica, gênero, idade, religião, identidade ou deficiência. Nós energizamos a sociedade, toda a sociedade, e não discriminamos com base em nossas diferenças.

  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica

  • Auxílio Óptico: reembolso para aquisição de lentes corretivas e armações;
  • Refeição: restaurante ou cartão refeição a depender da modalidade e localidade de trabalho;
  • Previdência Privada
  • Estacionamento/Veículo Fretado/Vale Transporte (a depender da localidade)
  • Gympass
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para colaboradoras mães;
  • Posto de atendimento bancário ou caixas eletrônicos;
  • Ambulatório médico com equipe médica e enfermagem, e outras especialidades;
  • Convênio com farmácia nas principais cidades brasileiras;
  • Atendimento de serviço social;
  • Massoterapia.

Overview

Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is a worldwide leader in this field. We are actively looking for a Junior level Mechanical Designer Technician to join our Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo office. As part of the Mechanical Group, the Mechanical Engineer Designer will have experience with solid bulk conveyance systems, hydraulic modelling and design of liquid bulk transmission systems, as well as utility (water / sewer / stormwater) systems. Experience in industrial complex and / or marine terminals are a plus.

About Moffatt & Nichol

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading infrastructure advisor specialising in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, ENR has ranked the company No. 1 design firm for Marine and Port Facilities in the United States and No. 7 internationally.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. The firm provides clients worldwide with customised service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practise areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

Duties and responsibilities

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • Prepare a variety of designs from agricultural bulk material, and mining bulk in Port Terminals or industrial plants
  • Prepare designs in waterfront facilities such as marinas, container terminals, marine oil terminals and pump stations and utilities (firefighting / water / sewer / stormwater) systems projects
  • Perform hydraulic modelling and analysis of liquid bulk transmission systems and utility (water / sewer / stormwater) systems
  • Prepare design documents (plans and specifications) with an emphasis on utility service design
  • Design piping to support projects such as liquid bulk terminals and utilities, including piping design using Plant 3D or similar software
  • Generate proposals and develop fee estimates for PS&E packages
  • Assist with condition assessment inspections for terminals equipment and utilities infrastructure

Other duties

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering (Desirable)
  • 2-6 years of experience in mechanical design related to bulk material handling
    • Experience in 3D piping design required
    • Plant 3D or equivalent (PDMS, PDS, etc.) experience required
  • Design experience in industrial complex and / or marine terminals is a plus
  • General understanding of process design, process flow diagram development, and piping and instrumentation diagram (P&ID) development
  • Acknowledgement in developing equipment specification, calculation, data sheets, drawings reviews and other documents related to mechanical design
  • Some planning and task management skills
  • Complete piping and pipelines stress analysis using CAESAR is a plus
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Spanish is an advantage
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171

Working conditions

Sedentary for prolonged period of time, interact with clients, and travel occasionally.

title: Amazon Logistics Station Leader, Amazon Logistics
description:
DESCRIPTION

At Amazon we treat every single day like its day one. And we never sit still while we do it. Are you up for crafting solutions and solving tomorrow’s problems today?

Then we have the opportunity for you! We’re seeking a Delivery Station Manager to join our Amazon Logistics team in Rio de Janeiro - RJ. You’ll operate out of one of our dynamic Delivery Stations: they are at the heart of Amazon’s rapidly growing Operations and Logistics network: they’re where we sort and process our parcels.

As a Delivery Station Manager, you’ll deliver inspiring, supportive leadership for the teams you lead. But at the same time, you don’t shy away from rolling up your sleeves and getting involved whenever necessary.

You’ll be directly responsible for developing a team of Shift Managers and their direct reports: meanwhile, you will report to the Senior Operations Manager. The quality of your leadership is key to success in this role: you’ll tactfully motivate and inspire your teams to do their best work, while planning schedules and activities that balance their needs with that of the business.

Another key aspect of the role is to lead on numerous process improvement projects, with the aim of streamlining all activities, both for yourself and the team members you lead. The ideas, innovation and leaps out of the status quo that you come up with could very well be rolled out across the Amazon network: this immense opportunity is yours for the taking.

KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Your role will be pivotal in the overall management, control, organization and direction of the Delivery Station. Your responsibilities will include, amongst others:

  • Maintaining Health and Safety standards within your remit area, while promoting and inspiring a culture of safety on-site;
  • Become proficient on specific, larger-scale processes and activities within Delivery Stations, such as 5S audits;
  • In your inventory control and systems environment, you’ll handle meaningful data collection, updating operations metrics on an hourly basis;
  • Therefore, you’ll aim to achieve productivity targets, reduce cost per unit, eliminate errors and ensure an excellent customer experience;
  • Partnering closely with other support teams (HR, Finance, Facilities, Safety and Security, IT) on staffing plans, schedules and performance levels;
  • Implement progressive process change and contribute in cross-functional Six Sigma initiatives within your site and the broader Brazil Amazon Logistics network.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
  • Employee and performance management experience;
  • Previous experience in leading large, diverse teams;
  • Expertise in two or more production or supply chain areas, with an impressive track record in a similar, dynamic logistics, distribution or manufacturing environment;
  • Ability to organize details, establish and carry out root cause analysis, and then extract and analyze the data you generate
  • Advanced level in Excel (vlookup, advanced formulas, pivot tables, macros);
  • Willingness to work flexible schedules/shifts/areas, including weekends, nights, and holidays;
  • Fluent Portuguese and basic English;

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Completed master’s degree or MBA; Experience with Kaizen and Lean methodologies and related techniques;
  • Ability to handle changing priorities and use good judgment in stressful situations;

Overview

Na PRIO, somos movidos por inconformismo, eficiência e ousadia para transformar o setor de óleo e gás. Crescemos rápido porque acreditamos em pessoas que pensam diferente, agem com autonomia e querem gerar impacto real. O Programa de Estágio PRIO 2026 é para quem quer aprender na prática, crescer com velocidade e fazer parte de uma empresa que valoriza ideias e protagonismo.

Na PRIO você vai encontrar:

  • Cultura inovadora com foco em resultados;
  • Projetos desafiadores com impacto direto no negócio;
  • Desenvolvimento acelerado, mentorias e treinamentos;

Se você quer mais do que um estágio, esse é o lugar certo para ser protagonista da sua carreira.

Programa de Estágio PRIO 2026

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Aqui, você não vai só observar, vai colocar a mão na massa desde o primeiro dia. Vai aprender ainda mais com quem está fazendo acontecer no mercado de óleo e gás.

Você vai participar e ajudar na análise de dados, acompanhar projetos estratégicos e colaborar com times que respiram inovação, criando soluções que geram valor real para a empresa.

Na PRIO, estagiário não é coadjuvante, é parte do time . Se você quer aprender, crescer e fazer a diferença, esse é o seu lugar.

O nosso Programa de estágio será presencial , no escritório de Botafogo.

O Programa tem duração de 1 ano, com a possibilidade de ser estendido por mais 1 ano.

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

Começamos em 2015 com apenas 10 pessoas e hoje somos mais de 1000. Crescemos com ousadia, colaboração e foco em resultado. Mas o que realmente nos diferencia é a nossa cultura: forte, viva e feita por gente que acredita no que faz.

Na PRIO, quem chega com vontade de aprender, crescer e fazer diferente, encontra espaço pra ir longe. Aqui, o protagonismo muda o jogo!

Ousadia, inconformismo, aprendizado e muuuita ralação.

Se você tem sangue nos olhos, vontade de aprender, gosta de desafios e muita conexão entre pessoas, inscreva-se no nosso Programa de Estágio.

Aqui, estagiário não é só estagiário. Quem entra pro time e manda bem, vira parte da equipe. Alguém que aprende, cresce e tem tudo pra construir uma carreira de sucesso com a gente.

Entenda o que move a PRIO.

Cada letra do nosso nome carrega um pedacinho da nossa cultura. Conhecer isso pode ser o primeiro passo pra fazer parte do nosso mundo.

Na PRIO, valorizamos quem trabalha bem em equipe, quem tem coragem para propor ideias inovadoras e não se conforma com o status quo. Aqui, buscamos pessoas que gostam de desafiar padrões e que têm paixão por entregar resultados cada vez melhores.

title: Designer, Marketing

About Darkroom

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.

Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. ), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).

As a Designer, you’ll help shape the evolution of Darkroom’s brand, website, and digital user experience, from case study pages and service modules to asset selection and overall site identity. You’ll work closely with the Marketing Team Design Lead, crafting visual assets and layouts in tools like Figma and Framer to strengthen our digital presence. Collaborating cross-functionally with the marketing team, you’ll bring our brand to life through thoughtful web design, compelling case studies, and high-impact marketing assets.

In this role, you’ll drive the creation of a consistent and scalable design system that reinforces Darkroom’s brand presence, building best-in-class digital experiences that are both visually stunning and conversion-optimized. You’ll ensure our web touchpoints reflect our creative standards while producing marketing creative that aligns with strategy and drives measurable impact.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal and Brazil.

What You’ll Do

Marketing Design & Brand System

  • Create marketing assets across paid media, organic, and social that are deeply aligned with the Darkroom brand system.

  • Maintain quality, consistency, and visual excellence across all external-facing materials.

  • Contribute to and maintain our Figma-based design system to ensure design scalability and cohesion.

  • Translate marketing objectives into design deliverables that support performance goals and strategic outcomes.

Website & Digital Experience

  • Design new case study pages, service modules and marketing content across our website.

  • Help shape user journeys and design for conversion, user clarity, and seamless experience across devices.

  • Collaborate with the Marketing team to ensure design aligns with storytelling and brand experience.

  • Design visually engaging email layouts in Figma for newsletters and outbound campaigns.

Framer & No-Code Development

  • Build and deploy high-quality, responsive website pages in Framer , including interaction design and animations.

  • Handle transitions, micro-interactions, and component responsiveness across mobile, tablet, and desktop.

  • Conduct quality assurance checks to ensure pixel-perfect implementation.

  • Continuously optimize site performance (speed, responsiveness) and contribute to A/B testing frameworks.

You’re a Great Fit If You

  • Have 3-4+ years of experience in web, brand, or marketing design, ideally within a fast-paced creative environment or agency.

  • Possess a strong portfolio that showcases website layout, interactive design, and marketing collateral.

  • Are fluent in Figma, including use of components, auto layout, and systemized design workflows.

  • Have hands-on experience with Framer or similar no-code web platforms.

  • Understand UX principles, responsive behavior, animation basics, and component logic.

  • Are proactive, organized, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of accountability.

  • Think strategically and can tie visual design decisions to performance and brand goals.

  • Can communicate design intent clearly for development hand-off and collaborate with engineers when needed.

Marketing Team Requirements

  • You understand how Marketing affects consumer psychology and behavior and you apply these principles to your design.

  • A self-starter with strong attention to detail and a proactive mindset

  • You are self-motivated and proactive with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for detail-oriented deliverables

  • You understand how to turn ideas and discussions into actionable next steps.

  • You have a proven track record of collaborating with developers or engineers, and understand how to document your designs for development hand-off.

What it's like to work at Darkroom

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:

  • Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements

description:
Overview

Somos a Eletrobras, empresa líder em geração e transmissão de energia elétrica no Brasil e na América Latina. Por meio de nossos ativos, contribuímos para que a matriz energética brasileira seja uma das mais limpas e renováveis do mundo. Alinhados à nossa Cultura e Propósito, trabalhamos de forma integrada para contribuir com o desenvolvimento sustentável que gere valor para toda a sociedade.

Se você quer fazer parte da nossa companhia e se tornar um de nossos talentos, saiba que estamos com uma oportunidade em aberto, em modelo presencial .

Com o seu talento podemos ir ainda mais longe, sempre guiados pelo nosso propósito de cuidar do planeta entregando a energia em que a gente acredita.

Vem com a gente, junte-se à Nossa Energia!

Atenção: A Eletrobras não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar auditorias e inspeções de SSO nos fornecedores a fim de verificar o atendimento dos requisitos legais e da Eletrobras;
  • Identificar não conformidades/oportunidades de melhorias e recomendar ações de redução dos riscos de SSO;
  • Participação e acompanhamento de investigações de acidentes de trabalho ocorridos;
  • Realização do processo de abrangência das lições aprendidas com acidentes (funcionários próprios ou terceiros) junto com os fornecedores;
  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios que reflitam os resultados de inspeções, indicadores, acidentes para diferentes públicos;
  • Sanar dúvidas e questionamentos dos stakeholders internos e externos relacionados ao processo de gerenciamento de saúde e segurança ocupacional (SSO) dos fornecedores;
  • Estabelecer programas de workshops, eventos e capacitação de fornecedores para reforçar a cultura de SSO;
  • Promover a melhoria contínua de processos, otimização de sistemas e atendimento às exigências das normas internas, com base nas melhores práticas do mercado;
  • Realizar benchmarkings relacionados ao tema com outras empresas do setor;

Formação

Obrigatórias

  • Graduação completa nas áreas correlatas a Meio Ambiente, Saúde e/ou Segurança do Trabalho.
  • Pós-graduação em Engenharia de Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Curso técnico em segurança do trabalho;

Qualificações

  • Conhecimentos na ISO 14001 e ISO 45001;
  • Conhecimento e experiência prática em utilização do Power BI;
  • Pacote Office intermediário;
  • Conhecimento e desenvolvimento de métricas de performance em SSO;
  • Conhecimento em SAP;
  • Experiência em metodologias de investigação de acidentes (e.g. Ishikawa, análise de árvore de causas, análise de modo e efeito de falha (FMEA), Sologic, bowtie, 5 porquês, entre outros);
  • Curso de Power BI focado em criação de dashboards e BIs;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Certificação de auditor líder ou interno na ISO 14001 e ISO 45001;
  • Cursos e certificados de metodologia de investigação de acidentes (e.g. Ishikawa, análise de árvore de causas, análise de modo e efeito de falha (FMEA), Sologic, bowtie, 5 porquês, entre outros);

Experiência (obrigatórias)

  • Mínimo de 6 anos de experiência comprovada como em atuação dentro da área de SSO, sendo pelo menos 3 anos em atuação em empresas de atividades de alto risco (empresas de grau de risco 3 ou 4 conforme NR 04).
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de SSO de fornecedores em todo o ciclo de vida do contrato (qualificação, contratação, mobilização, gestão e desmobilização).
  • Experiência em liderar e executar investigações de acidente do trabalho com uso de metodologias consistentes para identificação de causas raízes, ações de melhoria, ações de abrangência e correto monitoramento da implementação das ações;
  • Experiência em compilação de informações aplicáveis ao processo de gerenciamento de SSO, análise de dados, apresentação de indicadores, elaboração de procedimentos, padrões, indicadores, apresentações gerenciais da área;
  • Experiência em inspeções e auditorias sistema de gestão de SSO (análise documental e avaliação em campo).
  • Experiência investigação de acidentes e elaboração de planos de ações.

Competências técnicas

  • Análise de Dados: experiência em análise exploratória de dados, estatística descritivas e inferenciais para identificar padrões e tendências;
  • Ferramentas de Visualização: domínio em ferramentas como Power BI ou Tableau para criar visualizações claras e informativas;
  • Mineração de dados: capacidade de extrair dados relevantes de diferentes fontes e formatos;
  • Raciocínio Lógico: capacidade de análise crítica e pensamento lógico para interpretar dados financeiros complexos;

Competências comportamentais

  • Comunicação
  • Proatividade
  • Autonomia/autoconfiança na execução do trabalho
  • Influenciador para todas de decisão em trabalhos em equipe
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Foco em resultado
  • Adaptabilidade e Resiliência
  • Organização

Benefícios

  • Alimentação: Vale-refeição e vale-alimentação;
  • Plano Médico e Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio educacional;
  • Universidade corporativa interna que contribui com a aprendizagem diária dos profissionais

Se esses benefícios e essa posição fazem sentido para você, inscreva-se já!

  • Step 4: Teste de Aptidão Física - TAF

Sobre a Eletrobras

Cuidamos do planeta entregando a energia em que a gente acredita. Somos uma empresa com capacidade instalada de 44.6 GW, presente em todas as regiões do país e referência em energia de baixo carbono. Com mais de seis décadas, promovemos um ambiente seguro, íntegro, respeitoso e inclusivo, oferecendo oportunidades de desenvolvimento aos profissionais. Venha fazer parte da Nossa Energia. description:
Our Hiring Process

  • We will review your application against our job requirements. We do not employ machine learning technologies during this phase as we believe every human deserves attention from another human. We do not think machines can evaluate your application quite like our seasoned recruiting professionals—every person is unique. We promise to give your candidacy a fair and detailed assessment.
  • We may then invite you to submit a video interview for the review of the hiring manager. This video interview is often followed by a test or short project that allows us to determine whether you will be a good fit for the team.
  • At this point, we will invite you to interview with our hiring manager and/or the interview team. Please note: We do not conduct interviews via text message, Telegram, etc. and we never hire anyone into our organization without having met you face-to-face (or via Zoom). You will be invited to come to a live meeting or Zoom, where you will meet our INFUSE team.
  • From there on, it's decision time! If you are still excited to join INFUSE and we like you as much, we will have a conversation about your offer. We do not make offers without giving you the opportunity to speak with us live.

INFUSE is committed to complying with applicable data privacy and security laws and regulations. For more information, please see our Privacy Policy.

Innovation is a core value of INFUSE . We are bringing together people, who can look into the future to understand better how technology will shape businesses, and people, who create and navigate projects with great potential impact. We are looking for a knowledgeable and highly motivated Level 3 IT Support Specialist to join our dynamic team.

As a Level 3 IT Support Specialist , you will be responsible for providing expert-level support for Azure, Microsoft 365, and Google services. You will work closely with our support team to resolve complex technical issues, implement solutions, and optimize our usage of these platforms. Your role will also involve mentoring junior staff and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure technical excellence.

What You'll Do:

  • Architect and optimize enterprise-scale solutions across Azure, M365, and Google Workspace
  • Lead critical incident resolution and serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges
  • Design and implement zero-trust security architectures that protect without hindering productivity
  • Manage Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) environments
  • Deploy Microsoft security baselines and Defender for Endpoint across our infrastructure
  • Architect Data Loss Prevention strategies using MS Purview with automatic sensitivity labeling
  • Implement Privileged Identity Management (PIM) with intelligent approval workflows
  • Configure compliance reporting and vulnerability assessment frameworks
  • Build sophisticated automation using PowerShell, Logic Apps, and Azure Runbooks
  • Create self-healing infrastructure and automated provisioning workflows
  • Design Windows Autopilot deployments for zero-touch device provisioning
  • Implement automated device cleanup policies and lifecycle management
  • Lead domain-to-cloud migrations with minimal business disruption
  • Implement Intune VM Management for next-generation device control
  • Drive adoption of AI tools and automation solutions
  • Mentor junior engineers and share your expertise
  • Create comprehensive technical documentation and troubleshooting procedures
  • Lead knowledge transfer sessions and establish change management processes

Requirements:

  • Cloud Mastery : Deep expertise in Azure (AVD, networking, cost management), M365 administration, and Google Workspace
  • Security Focus : Hands-on experience with Entra ID and Microsoft security frameworks
  • Automation Expertise : Advanced PowerShell scripting and experience with modern automation platforms
  • Device Management : Proven track record with Intune, Windows Autopilot, and endpoint management
  • Infrastructure Knowledge : Strong networking, Windows OS (including Windows 11), and Hyper-V skills
  • Azure Virtual Desktop : Managing pooled and personal VMs
  • Data Protection : Microsoft Purview implementation, DLP policies, sensitivity labeling
  • Integration Development : API development
  • 5+ years in enterprise IT infrastructure roles
  • Demonstrated success in cloud migrations and modernization projects
  • Experience with ITIL frameworks and ITSM tools (Jira, Confluence, InFlow)
  • Track record of implementing security best practices and compliance frameworks
  • Proven ability to deliver efficiency improvements through automation

Would be an advantage:

  • Relevant Microsoft certifications (Azure, M365, Security, Intune)
  • Experience with AI/ML tools and their practical applications
  • Background in large-scale enterprise transformations (1000+ devices)
  • Cost optimization achievements in cloud environments (30%+ reduction targets)
  • Experience with phased rollout strategies and risk mitigation

Personal Attributes:

  • Problem-solver who thrives on complex challenges
  • Excellent communicator who can translate technical concepts for any audience
  • Self-motivated with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and priorities
  • Fluent English (Upper-Intermediate or higher)

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary aligned with your expertise
  • Flexible payment options (bank transfer, Payoneer, PayPal)
  • Comprehensive paid time off and sick leave
  • Summer Fridays (shortened workdays)
  • Monday-Friday schedule
  • Shift 1: 12 AM - 9 AM EST (Boston) (includes 1-hour break)
  • Shift 2: 9 AM - 6 PM EST (Boston) (includes 1-hour break)
  • Remote work flexibility

If you're passionate about building secure, scalable, and innovative infrastructure solutions that deliver 1000x efficiency improvements, we want to hear from you. Join INFUSE and help us shape the future of technology.

A InEvent é uma startup B2B inovadora e ágil que desenvolve soluções inteligentes para eventos e marketing em grandes empresas, criando gerenciamento de alto nível para executivos e ferramentas operacionais robustas para analistas e gerentes.

QUEM SOMOS

A InEvent é uma empresa de tecnologia de eventos remotos com InEventers em mais de 13 países diferentes, falando mais de 27 idiomas diferentes. Somos uma equipe global.

Os InEventers são uma equipe única, com visão de crescimento e valores compartilhados. Nós permitimos que você seja você mesmo e encorajamos a comunicação aberta. O mais importante aqui não é a sua experiência, mas sim a sua curiosidade e paixão por aprender e crescer conosco!

Quality Analyst

  • Corrigir e resolver problemas e falhas de segurança encontrados nos testes;
  • Analisar os resultados dos testes e informar a equipe de desenvolvimento;
  • Trabalhar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para corrigir bugs e erros;
  • Aprender os modelos de desenvolvimento utilizados em nossas plataformas;
  • Inovar e reestruturar parte de nossos sistemas.

  • Formação ou cursando Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas;
  • Bom conhecimento de trabalho em software de gerenciamento de testes, linguagens de programação e metodologias de QA;
  • Boa capacidade de trabalho em equipe e pensamento crítico;
  • Capacidade de aprender e perceber rapidamente a resolução de problemas;
  • Criatividade e curiosidade para aprender e aplicar novos conceitos em nossas plataformas;
  • Gostar de hackathons, ter o espírito de um hacker - quando solicitado, resolver o problema com paixão e vontade.

BENEFÍCIOS

  • Paid Time Off (PTO);
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Presente de aniversário e presentes de aniversário de trabalho;
  • Dia de aniversário off.

description:
Overview

You execute strategies, implement Lean tools, and support improvement activities and initiatives to drive operational improvements. Your role is crucial in facilitating continuous improvement initiatives, training, and change management.

Responsibilities

  • You develop, lead, execute, sustain, and standardize process and improvement projects, using the appropriate tools and measuring the effectiveness of the implemented actions.
  • You implement and facilitate Continuous Improvement initiatives across all operational and support areas. This involves identifying bottlenecks, optimizing processes, and driving operational excellence.
  • You maintain the Operations Management System: You are also responsible for maintaining and enhancing SBM’s operations management system, such as KPI's and operational routines.
  • You train and guide people in the use of continuous improvement tools (root cause analysis, A3, PDCA, SMED, 5S, Visual Communication, SIPOC, Process flow chart, etc.).
  • You pilot, monitor and report productivity dashboards using Power BI. Promote quick onboarding to understand complex processes and identify opportunities via data.
  • You execute and maintain the Lessons Learned process in the Region, ensuring inputs from unit incidents and events are captured, addressed, documented, and incorporated into operational practices.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • Certification in Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt or Black Belt preferred) or other relevant continuous improvement methodologies.

Experience

  • Experience in operations management, continuous improvement, or process engineering, preferably within a similar industry or local setting.
  • Hands-on experience with Lean tools and methodologies, including leading A3 problem-solving and performance evaluation.

Executive Tournament Director

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the biggest female sporting event in the world, the pinnacle of women’s football globally and the main showcase for our sport, our athletes, our Member Associations, and our fans. FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

THE POSITION

The Executive Tournament Director, under the guidance of FIFA’s Chief Women’s Football Officer will be responsible for leading the team in Brazil tasked with the successful delivery of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. The Executive Tournament Director will represent FIFA in Brazil as the primary lead on all tournament related matters in close consultation and collaboration with the CBF, the Brazilian Government, State Governments, local authorities and the Brazilian Football stakeholders. In particular, the Tournament Director will ensure that the strategy, objectives and operational milestones for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 are achieved in a timely manner, within the agreed budgets and in accordance with all FIFA and Brazilian laws, rules and regulations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • The Executive Tournament Director will be directly responsible for all administrative, commercial, financial, legal, communication and reporting matters related to the tournament guided by and in close collaboration with the relevant FIFA Chief Officers and the Head of the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will oversee and support the work of the Executive Operations Director to ensure that all operational milestones are delivered to a high standard, within agreed timeframes and within targeted financial parameters.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will also serve as a key representative and spokesperson for the event in Brazil, effectively engaging with stakeholders, participants, and media to promote its mission and values in close collaboration with the Chief Women’s Football Officer and Head of the FIFA Women’s World Cup.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will form part of the FWWC2027 Senior Leadership Team together with the FIFA Head of the FIFA Women’s World Cup and the FIFA27 Executive Operations Director.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will be responsible for ensuring effective delivery from all Departments and key functional areas involved in the tournament delivery in close collaboration with the Executive Operations Director.
  • The Executive Tournament Director will be responsible for ensuring seamless collaboration and reporting into the FIFA Leadership.

YOUR PROFILE

  • A minimum of 10 years’ experience in leading roles in sports event management and delivery.
  • Proven track record in international event delivery with clear achievement of KPIs on budget, event objectives and operational milestones.
  • Experience in working with the Brazilian Federal and State Governments.
  • Capacity to make key decisions for the business through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement.
  • Clear experience in managing multi-million-dollar event budgets.
  • Experience in managing multi-disciplined teams across a variety of business areas.
  • Ability to effectively monitor employees’ organisational performance and implement decisive corrective actions.
  • Ability to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain highly qualified employees.
  • Have the following strengths: high energy levels, entrepreneurial spirit, motivational leadership, effective negotiation skills, excellent communication skills and positive relationship-management skills.
  • Competent IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams).
  • Knowledge of event planning and event project management processes (project management certification such as PRINCE2 or PMP an advantage).
  • Experience and knowledge of the local culture and political structures in Brazil.
  • Experience of working in football is an advantage.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women\u2019s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women\u2019s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Expert 3: Forest management and Conservation Expert with national experience

Posted on: 29 Aug, 2025 Application by: 10 Sep, 2025 Project status: Tender Project title: Action4Forests – Improve conditions for access to and implementation of REDD+ in Brazil

Period of project: December 2025- Jun 2027 Duration of assignment: 18 months Country: Brazil Job code: 38948

The Action4Forests project is designed to enhance Brazil's capacity to implement effective REDD+ (Reducing Emissions from Deforestation and Forest Degradation) strategies, focusing on the Amazon region. Coordinated by Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) , in close collaboration with the Brazilian Ministry of the Environment and Climate Change (MMA) and the National Development Bank (BNDES) , this initiative aims to improve access to and the effective implementation of climate finance for forest protection. Running from 2024 to 2028 , the project supports Brazil’s ambitious goal of reducing deforestation, conserving forests, and generating carbon credits through jurisdictional REDD+ programs. Key activities include strengthening governance structures at both subnational and national levels, facilitating access to carbon markets, and empowering Indigenous Peoples and Local Communities (IPLC) to actively participate in REDD+ processes. The project is structured around three main outputs:

  • Action4Governments : Enhancing the capacity of subnational governments to access and implement financial resources for forest protection.
  • Action4People : Strengthening IPLC-led organizations, particularly women-led groups, to access finance for forest conservation and carbon market engagement.
  • Action4Funds : Supporting the strategic positioning of the Amazon Fund and other financial mechanisms in alignment with evolving carbon market legislation, focusing on gender-sensitive, sustainable forest financing.
  • Work location is Rio de Janeiro, Brasilia or other locations in the Amazon Region, Brazil.
  • Implementation of Output 1, 2 and 3 activities in close consultation with the GIZ team.
  • Proactively coordinate activities and seek synergies between Outputs 1, 2 and 3.
  • Coordination with relevant public, private and civil society partners in close consultation with GIZ.
  • Coordination with the Expert Pool.
  • Support Implementation of activities defined in the Project´s Annual Operational Plan and herewith contributing to the fulfillment of the Project´s GIZ/BMZ indicators.
  • Participatory development and adaptation of gender sensitive approaches.

Qualifications

  • Education/training: University degree in one the following interdisciplinary fields: forestry / forest science / ecology / geography / sustainable development / environmental economics or comparable related field
  • Language: Knowledge of English B2 level (5 out of 10 points) and Portuguese C2 (5 out of 10 points), in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages
  • General professional experience: 7 years of professional experience in the field of sustainable forest management and project implementation (including planning, coordination, and execution of forest-related initiatives aimed at biodiversity conservation, ecosystem restoration, and sustainable use of forest resources)
  • Specific professional experience: 5 years of professional experience in the development and implementation (equal weight) of forest carbon projects
  • Professional experience in the country/ region of assignment: 5 years of professional experience in the Brazilian Amazon
  • Experience in the field of development cooperation: 3 years of experience in development cooperation projects
  • Other: 3 years of professional experience in sustainable forest management with IPLC

title: Center Director, PANAFTOSA

Overview

Closing Date: September 25, 2025, 11:59 PM Brasilia Standard Time

Primary Location: Rio De Janeiro, Brazil

Organization: AFT Centro Panamericano de Fiebre Aftosa (PANAFTOSA)

Schedule: Full time

Description of Duties / Organizational Context

The incumbent is responsible for the management of the Pan American Foot-and-Mouth Disease Center and Veterinary Public Health (PANAFTOSA), providing leadership on the principles and implementation of PAHO’s technical cooperation on Veterinary Public Health and One Health. The incumbent promotes the applications of One Health good practices and is responsible for the management and administration of the Center’s human and financial resources and fixed assets. He/she must maintain a harmonious and effective collaboration with counterparts in national and international administrations, and non-government, philanthropic, academic and private organizations, from the public health, agriculture and animal health sectors. The incumbent should cultivate and maintain a close professional relationship with Brazilian Authorities, particularly those related to the operation and maintenance of the Center, in accordance with the Agreement signed by the Government of Brazil with PAHO for the Center. The incumbent follows broadly stated guidance in terms of policy and mission of the Organization and has the authority to establish guidelines of major importance on programmatic activities and Center’s management and administration operations to address problems that might require complex considerations and alternative possible solutions, involving internal and external stakeholders. The incumbent acts as prime advisor of the Organization to discuss problems and seek solutions on VPH and One Health policy issues in direct coordination with the Assistant Director in the area of One Health. The incumbent will be responsible for the VPH and One Health component of the PAHO Strategic Plan and Biennial Work Plans, within the framework of the policy orientations and mandates of the Governing Bodies.

Summary of Responsibilities

Under the direct supervision of the Director, Communicable Diseases and Environmental Determinants of Health (CDE) and the general supervision of the Assistant Director (AD), the incumbent is responsible for the following duties:

  • Lead the Organization’s technical cooperation on Veterinary Public Health (VPH) for the elimination of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), food safety and antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in the food of animal origin value chain, and the prevention, control/elimination of zoonotic and foodborne diseases and envenomation in the Americas, consistent with the One Health approach.
  • Direct, manage, plan, organize, implement and evaluate programs necessary to achieve the aims and objectives of the Center’s technical cooperation, including field interventions, research, training and dissemination of information.
  • Provide technical expertise and lead the normative function of the Organization regarding food safety and control/elimination of FMD and zoonotic diseases in collaboration with partners, academia, ministries of health, ministries of agriculture, and other stakeholders.
  • Advise and promote inter-programmatic work across the Organization to ensure efficient use of resources and alignment with biennium work plans and strategic priorities.
  • Lead and direct the management and administration of the Center, ensuring alignment with the Strategic Plan, Biennial Work Plans, UNDSS security requirements, and business continuity planning.
  • Direct and guide technical cooperation for strengthening national and international disease information and surveillance systems on FMD, and foodborne and zoonotic diseases.
  • Direct technical cooperation for strengthening national laboratories and international laboratory networks, including training programs and coordinating reference services.
  • Oversee the Organization’s WOAH Reference Laboratory on FMD and WOAH Collaborating Center on Veterinary Public Health.
  • Mobilize human and financial resources in support of national programs and cooperate with member states in designing and evaluating project proposals.
  • Serve as the Secretary of COSALFA and REDIPRA, including planning and managing meetings and presenting at international events.
  • Provide leadership to staff in a multicultural environment, mentor supervised staff, set objectives, conduct performance reviews, and promote staff development.
  • Promote ethical behavior and integrity in line with PAHO’s Code of Ethical Principles and Conduct.
  • Provide a stable managerial framework and advise Member States’ institutions in the area of expertise.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Key Behavioral Competencies

Overall attitude at work: Maintains integrity, ethical approach, and accountability; respects colleagues and counterparts.

Respecting and valuing individual differences: Treats everyone with dignity and respect; avoids stereotypes; considers others’ perspectives.

Teamwork: Fosters collaboration across the Organization, builds partnerships, and maintains an effective network.

Communication: Articulates strategic objectives, adapts to audiences, and shares knowledge and directives effectively.

Creating an empowering and motivating environment: Provides direction, motivates teams, and promotes autonomy and high performance.

Ensuring effective use of resources: Sets measurable objectives, allocates resources, and monitors progress.

Driving the Organization to a successful future: Leads with vision, fosters a culture of long-term goals, and rewards progress.

Technical Expertise

  • Technical: Extensive senior experience in managing complex human/animal health programs at national and international levels; strong knowledge of public and animal health, veterinary public health, surveillance, and evidence-based advisory capabilities.
  • Managerial: Senior management experience in large administrations; proficiency in health administration, international legislation, negotiation, and organizational development.
  • Administrative: Resource mobilization, financial management, and administration platforms for Finance, Budget, HR, and Infrastructure; ability to handle confidential information.

Education (Qualifications)

Essential: University degree in veterinary medical science, and a master’s degree in public health, veterinary public health, animal health, veterinary epidemiology, or related field from an accredited institution.

Desirable: Doctoral degree in a public health or animal health-related area.

Experience

Essential: Thirteen years of progressively increased responsibilities in national and international management, with experience designing, planning, executing, and evaluating technical cooperation related to public and animal health; involvement in international technical cooperation programs and activities in veterinary public health and One Health; experience with FMD, food safety, zoonoses, and epidemiological surveillance at the international level.

Languages

Very good knowledge of English and Spanish with a working knowledge of another language. Knowledge of Portuguese and/or French would be an asset.

IT Skills

Demonstrated ability to use current technology and software, ERP and management information systems; proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, OneDrive, PowerPoint, Teams, Visio, SharePoint and Project is an asset.

Disclaimer & Application Details

  • This vacancy notice may be used to fill other similar positions at the same grade and level.

  • All applicants are required to complete an online profile to be considered for this post.

  • Candidates will be contacted only if they are under serious consideration.

  • If selected for interview, provide scanned copies of required degrees/certificates. PAHO considers official qualifications from accredited institutions as recognized by WHED/IAU/UNESCO, CHEA, and NCES.

  • Assessment of credentials can be performed via listed sources: World Higher Education Database (WHED), Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA), and College Navigator (NCES).

  • Links (plain text): whed.net, chea.org, nces.gov.

  • Any appointment/extension is subject to PAHO Staff Regulations, Staff Rules and e-Manual.

PAHO/WHO is committed to:

  • PAHO supports an environment of mutual respect and dignity for all applicants. All interested individuals who meet the requirements are encouraged to apply.

  • Persons with disabilities can request reasonable accommodations to participate in recruitment; contact

  • Maintaining high standards of integrity and accountability in professional and personal activities.

  • Promoting a work environment free from harassment, discrimination, and abusive behavior. Background checks will be conducted.

  • Providing a smoke-free environment.

  • Zero tolerance for sexual exploitation and abuse; wrongdoing may lead to termination and legal action.

title: Senior Fund Accountant - Implementations
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page .

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

The Team You'll Work With

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. The team ensures whatever information our clients had before joining Carta is correctly migrated into our system. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in an accounting role where you executed all aspects of end of quarter and year closes, preferably working within the Venture Capital Fund Administration environment
  • Strong accounting analysis skills with the ability to interpret a story through multiple years of unstructured data, and reproduce Financial Statements correctly
  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white-glove service
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

  • $102,000 - $120,000 in San Francisco, CA, Santa Clara, CA, and New York, NY
  • $96,900 - $114,000 in Seattle, WA

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the recruiter via email. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.

Important Security Notice for Candidates

Our company has been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com domain . Be cautious of any requests for sensitive information or payments outside of our official channels. For more information about this type of scam, please review the guidelines provided by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately to .

Awards and Acknowledgements

Companies and funds like Tribe and Pipe build their businesses on Carta. The company has been included on the Forbes World’s Best Cloud Companies , Fast Company's Most Innovative list, and Inc.’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies . We’ve also been recognized as a 2023 Built In Best Place to Work in the U.S. , a Muse VIBE Award winner in the Vacation and Time Off category and certified as a Great Place to Work .

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Site Reliability Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of globally distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Site Reliability Engineer

Our goal is to perfect enterprise infrastructure DevOps practices, raising the bar on what's possible with automation by embracing a model-driven approach, whether on-premise or on public clouds.

We run hundreds of private cloud, Kubernetes clusters, and applications for customers across both physical and public cloud estates. We identify and address incidents, monitor and observe applications, anticipate potential issues, and enable product refinement to ultimately achieve high-quality standards in our open source portfolio.

To succeed in this role, you need to have a strong background in Linux, Python, networking, and knowledge of how clouds work. Your work will encompass the entire stack, from bare-metal networking and kernel up to Kubernetes and open source applications. FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Training Site Infrastructure Manager reports to the FWWC27 Head of Infrastructure and Technical Services and FIFA Training Sites Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Tournament Infrastructure team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.

The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA\'s exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

This position plays a pivotal role in the planning, development, and delivery of infrastructure at FIFA Women\'s World Cup 2027 training sites across Brazil. Working alongside the FIFA Training Site Manager and in coordination with Team Services, Technical Services, Pitch Management, Venue Design, Dressing & Signage, Media Operations, Partnerships and external stakeholders (Training Site Authorities and Football Clubs), the role is responsible for ensuring all training sites are operationally ready and compliant with FIFA’s requirements and standards.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in architectural and interior design, technical project management, stakeholder coordination, and large-scale international event delivery. As demonstrated through global events such as FIFA World Cups and Olympic Games. They will manage the implementation of training site upgrades, including renovations, overlays, and delivery of essential infrastructure, with a focus on strategic planning, design integration, and resource optimization.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the design and infrastructure delivery strategy for all FWWC2027 training sites, incorporating best practices in venue planning, design management, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Coordinate the implementation of renovations and upgrades, overseeing construction quality, progress, and alignment with FIFA’s requirements and standards.
  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of overlay and technical service delivery, including scope definition, scheduling, procurement, installation, and handover.
  • Engage with Training Site Authorities, contractors, and internal teams to ensure seamless collaboration and delivery.
  • Implement project controls for budgeting, reporting, and risk mitigation.
  • Ensure sustainability, cultural alignment, and aesthetic quality across all training site environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Pitch Management, Cleaning & Waste, Venue Design, and Dressing & Signage to ensure cohesive delivery.

YOUR PROFILE

  • 10+ years of experience in architectural design, project management, and delivery of international sporting event infrastructure.
  • Proven track record in managing venue delivery and readiness, overlay operations, or major venue infrastructure for events like FIFA World Cup or Olympics.
  • Strong technical expertise in space planning, stakeholder communication, and procurement processes.
  • Bachelor\'s or Master’s Degree in Project Management, Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women\'s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women\'s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: IT Systems Engineer / Analista de suporte de TI
description:
Be the energy behind change. Join ABL Group.

ABL Group is a leading global independent energy and marine consultant working in energy and oceans to de-risk and drive the energy transition across the renewables, maritime, and oil and gas sectors, offering the deepest pool of expertise across marine and engineering disciplines in more than 300 locations globally.

Working as a core member of our IT infrastructure team, you will provide 3rd line technical support. Working closely with our Service Desk and Infrastructure teams, you will be responsible for maintaining and managing our IT infrastructure to ensure that our colleagues have access to efficient and best-in-class IT services. You will also contribute to the development and evolution of ABL Group's IT posture. This position will support ABL Group staff across all of our regions where we operate.

What will you be doing?

  • Proactively maintain our Azure Cloud Infrastructure platform.
  • Monitor and maintain our backup and restore procedures and ensure they are in line with our policy.
  • Monitor escalated incidents to ensure SLAs are met.
  • Identify problems and trends to proactively prevent future incidents.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, including account setup, user desktops / laptops, system, and network configuration, both remote and local.
  • Promote collaboration within the team and ensure service desk procedures are followed.
  • Provide continual coaching & mentoring of technical and customer service skills.
  • Research and identify solutions to software and hardware issues.
  • Install, configure, and support Windows operating system and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ask internal customers targeted questions to quickly understand the root of the problem.
  • Provide technical and training to internal customer upon setup completion.
  • Maintain and use the company IT ServiceDesk logging system, ensuring all calls are up to date and prioritised accordingly so that SLAs are met.
  • Talk staff through a series of actions, either via phone, email or chat, until they’ve solved a technical issue.
  • Own critical problems and ensure handovers are in place to ensure continuity of work across regions.
  • Lead or support all prioritised project work in collaboration with other team members across the Group.
  • Assist in ensuring that the documentation of IT Services is accurate and maintained regularly.
  • Maintain confidentiality of company data and systems.

What are we looking for?

Ideally, you will be an experienced IT Systems Engineer who has worked in a similar role previously. You should have a background of working on the design of technical solutions and evaluating and implementing IT services, such as on-premise infrastructure. More specifically, we are looking for the following technical skills:

  • ITIL Foundation (v3 or 4).
  • Advanced Desktop and Server support skills with Azure Cloud.
  • Active Directory / Windows 10 / Office 365 / SharePoint / MS Teams experience.
  • Experienced in on-prem to cloud application management.
  • Expertise in global on-premises or cloud networking and security device management and configuration including, but not limited to, telephony, LAN/WAN (MPLS, SDWAN, etc) firewall management, etc.
  • Expert level technical experience in Azure Cloud, through design, implementation, and ongoing management.
  • Expert level understanding of Data Management principles and Azure storage solutions.
  • Knowledge of software design principles, languages, and architecture models.
  • Fluent in English.

Further Information:

This position will be based at our office in Rio de Janeiro.

You must have the right to live and work in Brazil.

Occasional travel to some ABL Group offices might be required.

You can learn more about our team and what we do here:

Please ensure that your application is written in English.

Our Commitment to D&I:

At ABL Group, we are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to thrive, regardless of background, identity, or role. As a global company, we believe that diversity drives innovation and inclusion strengthens our teams. We support flexible working, accessible environments, and employee wellbeing. Even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement, we encourage you to apply—your unique perspective could be just what we need.

Somos a Eletrobras, empresa líder em geração e transmissão de energia elétrica no Brasil e na América Latina. Por meio de nossos ativos, contribuímos para que a matriz energética brasileira seja uma das mais limpas e renováveis do mundo.

Vem com a gente, junte-se à Nossa Energia!

  • Analisar os desligamentos forçados ocorridos no Sistema Elétrico que estão sujeitos os ativos de geração e transmissão de Furnas, avaliando o desempenho de seus sistemas de proteção e Sistemas Especiais de Proteção – SEP, e emitir os relatórios evidenciando e propondo medidas mitigadoras, quando necessários, para não conformidades encontradas;
  • Elaborar estudos de coordenação de proteção, curto-circuito, viabilidade técnica de SEP solicitados pelo ONS e análises estatísticas dos desligamentos forçados;

  • Apoiar órgão de engenharia no projeto e especificação da modernização de novos sistemas de proteção e monitoramento, bem como participação em testes de pré-comissionamento e comissionamento destes sistemas;
  • Fazer gestão dos ativos de proteção, registradores de perturbação, medição fasorial e infraestruturas associadas a estes sistemas, planejando junto aos órgãos de engenharia a substituição ao fim da vida útil regulatória ou extensão de vida útil operacional;
  • Determinar modificações relativas aos sistemas de proteção dos geradores, transformadores, linhas de transmissão e demais equipamentos do sistema, após a respectiva entrega à operação, uma vez vencidos os períodos de garantia, visando maior disponibilidade dos ativos à operação;
  • Elaborar as diretrizes de manutenção dos sistemas de proteção, registradores de perturbação, medição fasorial e suas infraestruturas associadas;
  • Elaborar ou participar sequências de testes especiais, em laboratório próprio ou instalações de Furnas, dos sistemas de proteção e circuitos de controle de geradores, transformadores, linhas de transmissão e demais equipamentos, participando da análise dos resultados e da sua aplicação junto aos órgãos de manutenção;
  • Elaborar ou participar de testes de sistemas de proteção em laboratórios de Simulação Digital em Tempo Real – RTDS;
  • Apoiar a implantação de SEP e circuitos de controle, para atender recomendações provenientes de estudos sistêmicos do ONS;
  • Fornecer informações de desligamentos forçados ocorridas no sistema elétrico de Furnas integrantes do SIN e fazer a gestão das recomendações emitidas pelo ONS relacionadas aos sistemas de proteção e monitoramento;
  • Participar dos processos de gestão da segurança cibernética dos sistemas de proteção e monitoramento, implantando políticas para acesso e utilização, com vista à manutenção da disponibilidade e confiabilidade da rede de sistemas de proteção, registradores de perturbação e medição fasorial;
  • Realizar estudos para a substituição de sistemas de proteção;
  • Apoiar a Eletrobras Operação Sudeste nos assuntos relacionados aos desligamentos forçados junto ao ONS, ANEEL e MME.
